name: Velora UI
summary: Free MIT animated shadcn/ui components and landing templates from Colorlib.
gaps: Pilot includes 12 of ~100 free components — not a full inventory (blocks/templates not ingested as comps).
Pricing freemium: Free ($0 forever) covers components + complete SaaS template under MIT; Pro $99 lifetime (niche templates / Figma / private registry) excluded — Coming soon on pricing page.
Optional @velora namespace registration documented on get-started; URL install works without it.
iframe demos only; no dynamic-import smoke mounts in this packet.

components.name: Aurora Background
components.summary: Aurora gradient background for hero and section backdrops.
components.copyCode:
npx shadcn@latest add https://velora.colorlib.com/r/aurora-background.json

import { AuroraBackground } from "@/components/velora/aurora-background"

<AuroraBackground />

copyPrompt.text: Use Velora UI free MIT component `Aurora Background` (slug `aurora-background`) from https://velora.colorlib.com/components/aurora-background. Install with `npx shadcn@latest add https://velora.colorlib.com/r/aurora-background.json` or register `@velora=https://velora.colorlib.com/r/{name}.json` then `npx shadcn@latest add @velora/aurora-background`. Imports land under `@/components/velora/aurora-background`. Requires React + TypeScript + Tailwind (Next.js 16 / Tailwind 4 stack upstream); Motion peers as listed. License: MIT (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ColorlibHQ/velora-ui/main/LICENSE). Pricing freemium — free tier includes components + SaaS template; Pro ($99 lifetime niche templates) excluded.
